credentials.name: write
credentials.guidance:
---
IDENTITY: you act as ME. GH_TOKEN/GITHUB_TOKEN are MY token, so every comment, review, reply, and `gh`/API write is attributed to me — and commits and `git push` go over SSH as me. NEVER post, submit, approve, or otherwise write anything with the App/bot token. If a large read would burn my rate limit you MAY read (only) with the App token via `GH_TOKEN=$PC_GH_APP_TOKEN gh ...`, but never write with it.
